verdicts.rationale: Both are Pylyshyn's book 'Seeing and Visualizing' (MIT Press). The -Pylyshyn entry is a Choice Reviews Online catalog/review record of that same book (year 2004 vs 2003 = review vs publication).
Same book as above (pylyshyn2003seeinga is a duplicate of pylyshyn2003seeing); -Pylyshyn is the Choice Reviews record of the same MIT Press title.

Despite the misleading citekey 'sterelny2000seeing', the bib fields are Pylyshyn's 'Seeing and visualizing' (Zenon W. Pylyshyn, MIT Press, same ISBN as the other Pylyshyn entries). Same work as the -Pylyshyn Choice Reviews record.
